cross_platform_input_contract_validation.scope: 仅验证输入实体、case sizes、warmup/repeat；不声明源码、构建或计时实现等价

definitions.candidate_p1_to_p_total_speedup: median(parallel_total_ms, measured p=1) / median(parallel_total_ms, measured p)
definitions.cross_platform_limit: 本分析只验证输入与数据契约一致；源码、构建、OpenMP runtime 和主机环境等价性必须由两侧 manifest 与实验报告另行证明
definitions.fixed_residual_fraction_of_parallel_tota: 每个 measured 样本先计算 fixed_residual_ms / parallel_total_ms，再按 p 汇总 median/CV
definitions.fixed_residual_ms: symbolic_residual_ms + numeric_residual_ms；它是未分项时间，不能仅凭该字段断言全部为串行工作
definitions.linux_phase_source: Linux process CSV 的 adapter 阶段分解字段
definitions.official_phase_speedup: symbolic 或 numeric 的 measured p=1 串行阶段中位数 / 同一候选阶段 measured p 中位数
definitions.official_total_speedup: median(serial_total_ms, measured p=1) / median(parallel_total_ms, measured p)
definitions.phase_p1_to_p_speedup: 指定阶段 measured p=1 中位数 / 同阶段 measured p 中位数
definitions.sample_scope: 仅 sample_kind=measured 的独立子进程样本参与统计
definitions.sampling_contract: 固定 W=2、R=7，轮次按线程数升序/降序交替
definitions.statistics: median 为样本中位数；coefficient_of_variation 为总体标准差除以均值
definitions.windows_phase_source: Windows process CSV 每条 measured 记录的 raw_csv_path
